question: If awareness is not bound by time, how does it relate to space and manifestation?
premises: The connection of awareness with time has been refuted at length.
Own-awareness remains the basis of manifestation.
Awareness can unfold appearances as space.
inference: Therefore, free from time, own-awareness functions by spreading out space in whatever way it manifests.
plain_english: The connection of awareness with time has been refuted at length; therefore own-awareness functions just as it spreads out space.
